services.name: Camp Site
services.desc: Our Primitive Campsites are just what the ultimate camper ordered. A little off the busy path of the campground these sites are hidden away near our newest bath house. Our Primitive sites are still close to our Full Hookup RV sites. Cabins and Cottages are based on 4 guests. RV and Tent sites are based on 2 guests. Additional guests over the age of twelve will be charged at a rate of $5 per person, per night. All lodges and area rental rates are based on 4 guests. Additional guests over the age of twelve will be charged $10.00 per person, per night. There is a 2-night minimum on weekends and a 3-night minimum on Holidays for all our rental
